# Training Sign-off Forms {#sec-training-signoff-forms}

Each form covers one training section. The completing staff member dates the Completed column for each item. The verifying colleague (Steward or Delegated Steward) signs the Verified by column.

Store completed forms in: `docs/training/[StaffName]_[Track]_[Year].docx`
